title: Reject helper endpoint aliases before independent frame checks
head: 5803ce786556acfbfe686b7bc5a3c153f746dd14
body:
The frozen independent `audit_local.py` accepts a negative `helper_final` key that aliases a target endpoint. On the genuine v=112, R=480 word, key `-592` overwrites target 112's required rank-eight hyperplane with FULL. Adding the matching rank-one profile charge preserves every existing independent check. This is an endpoint-contract gap, not an understated invoice or a new supplier result.

This package reproduces actual acceptance for all 112 target aliases, adds a small helper-index guard, and preserves all 146 genuine words in the pinned positive census. Every alias also passes PR2478's unchanged cut-source guard, so this is a separate missing prerequisite. The native auditor already rejects it: the replay runs the native positive case and checks rejection at its exact helper-range assertion. An independently derived Gaussian coefficient and the unchanged exact Clifford code show the required and overwritten native endpoint labels differ.

Validation: Windows CPython 3.12.7 registered replay passed, including 115 actual original-auditor calls, the native positive/rejection pair, all 112 native label witnesses, negative/oversized/source/target/textual-alias controls, Git-free optimized guard CLI, and rejection of corrupted actual source before import. A separate AI reviewer independently reran the full optimized verifier on CPython 3.12.14, read the proof/source/guard and found no blocking issue. No selected supplier defect, full native wrong-output acceptance, kappa change, formal proof or human review is claimed. Exact pins, receipt, limits and open next questions are in `research/audit-helper-endpoint-indices`.

Canonical main remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Picker seed `21498ba0c0f0407250d688ef37ba1e64` selected independent verification; the changed card targets a missing source-to-certificate implication. Final REST overlap covered 701 open PRs with complete pagination at 12:56 UTC on 2026-10-15. The last complete Discussion snapshot has 1196 records at 12:17 UTC; its refresh failed due to GitHub GraphQL quota exhaustion and is explicitly retained as stale. PR2478's head was unchanged. PR1238's existing target end-cap theorem and PR2409's distinct native acceleration were read and distinguished.

Credit icekylinx for the independent auditor; DreamingOfClouds and the retained native/Clifford lineage; Jeremy Kothe and predecessors for the genuine word; and Marius-Paul Dumitrean for PR2478's cut audit and handoff. Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
